threshold: ≥2 documented patients; each tumor ≥1 TPM and strictly above N
meaning: N is the largest supported nonreproductive, non-Disposable normal context statistic; repeated libraries count once.

threshold: ≥5 × max(N, 1) TPM in ≥1 sample
meaning: One strong sample suffices, including one without a resolved patient ID.

threshold: ≥1 native nTPM
meaning: Includes reproductive, placental and developmental scope; normal exclusions still apply.

threshold: ≥1 nTPM and ≥20 reads
meaning: Indirect sites also require complete outside-cluster coverage, every outside value <1, and no curated normal-induction conflict.

threshold: Mean ≥1 TPM; ≥20 cells, ≥5 positive and ≥10% positive; positive means ≥1 TPM
meaning: Qualifying developmental lineage/stage; bulk fetal/reproductive scope is retained separately.

threshold: Reliable mapped positive IHC or reviewed human reproductive protein for every member
meaning: An alternative to RNA association; antibody/identity conflicts remain unresolved.

threshold: Vital 4/8/16/32; Protected 8/16/32/64; Manageable 16/32/64/128
meaning: Columns are missing/uncertain, Approved, Supported, Enhanced matched negative IHC. Units remain native TPM or nTPM.

threshold: One IHC rank increment, capped at rank 3
meaning: Only qualifying product-specific evidence; no stacking or override of injury/protein exclusions.

threshold: Above Vital/Protected ceiling → Unsafe; above Manageable ceiling → hold; Manageable >128 → Unsafe
meaning: Equality to the ceiling passes. Disposable and reproductive scope have no current numerical ceiling in this gate.

threshold: ≥20 reads
meaning: Cell-specific tier; only exact/declared compartment-matched IHC can supply credit.

threshold: Cell-specific 4/8/16 bases on native nTPM/TPM
meaning: No matched negative-IHC credit; a reproductive location does not exempt shared immune cells.

threshold: Third-highest reported TPM; ≥3 observations
meaning: Apply cell-specific ceiling; unpaired distributions keep their bounds.

threshold: ≥5 positive cells and ≥20 counts in ≥2 sample groups; RNA ceilings divided by 100
meaning: Native CP10K screening scale, not a TPM conversion.

threshold: ≥1% detected, ≥3,000 cells and ≥10 expressing cells
meaning: Existing brain/spinal cord/heart/lung panel: Vital → Unsafe; Protected → review hold.

threshold: Reliable non-Low positive in Vital/Protected → Unsafe; Manageable → hold
meaning: Low is flagged; uncertain is unresolved. Reviewed/external findings retain reagent, cell and identity scope.

threshold: Every nonreproductive combined-bulk tissue concept for every member
meaning: The comparison uses 36 concepts. Missing optional cell/immune/cornea panels alone does not block; observed exclusions still apply.

threshold: Reference coding CDS, or supported ncORF: MS peptide or ≥2 independent Ribo-seq studies
meaning: All proteins still undergo the normal screen.

threshold: Complete primary-locus coding sequence; no LoF/NMD, incomplete tags, internal stops or non-AA20 residues
meaning: MANE Select first, Ensembl canonical second; conflicting evidence requires review. X is not allowed.

threshold: <50 amino acids inside a same-strand coding gene without independent ncORF evidence
meaning: Other:Sequence.

threshold: ≥95% of 9-mers occur in Unsafe proteins
meaning: Other:Sequence; this does not create expression-based Unsafe evidence.

threshold: Recorded normal/(normal + reproductive maximum); previous >10% veto removed
meaning: Developmental and adult reproductive association now share the same admission flow.

threshold: Exact-member claim in a curated CA/CTA/oncofetal target source
meaning: Retain source, table and claim; neither automatic admission nor exemption from normal findings.

threshold: ≥10 × max(N, 1) TPM
meaning: Repeated route remains ≥2 patients at ≥1 TPM and above N.

threshold: max(cancer, reproductive/developmental) ≥1 and strictly above every measured nonreproductive value
meaning: Source-compatible values only; missing compartments are not zeros.

threshold: ≤32 TPM and ≤32 nTPM, assessed separately
meaning: No unit conversion or IHC-derived numerical allowance for these proposed caps.

threshold: Within-tumor p80/p90/p95; across-patient p80/p90/p95 with ≥20 measured patients
meaning: Within-tumor ranks use the full measured catalog; across-patient values use the lower observed order statistic.
